readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 现在 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Stamp the 土 earth under your feet to mark 现在—right now. Zài drops firmly onto the exact place and moment.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 使用 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Pull a tool from one section of the divided 使用（shǐ yòng） box, “use” it, then drop it firmly onto the workbench; yòng lands with the tool.
